name: token-usage
description: Token usage & cost analytics for Qoder desktop - covers both official models and custom BYOK models, with a self-contained visual HTML dashboard, an in-IDE Canvas dashboard, and a /token-usage slash command that works in any workspace.
descriptionZh: 统计 Qoder 桌面端 token 消费（官方模型 + 自定义模型），支持费用换算、可视化 HTML 仪表盘与 IDE 内 Canvas 仪表盘，并提供任意工作区可用的 /token-usage 斜杠命令。
